Again - Interactive Crime Novel.name: Again
Again - Interactive Crime Novel.summary: FBI special agent Jonathan "J" Weaver is a man out for answers -- answers as to why he alone survived a series of connected murders that eradicated his family 18 years ago. But when a current-day investigation turns up clues that are identical to the killings that claimed his family, J looks to the past -- literally -- to unravel the mystery. Could it be that this most heinous chain of crimes is happening... again?

Barbie - Jet, Set & Style!.name: Barbie: Jet, Set & Style!
Barbie - Jet, Set & Style!.summary: Fly around the world as Barbie helping her friends with fashion emergencies.

Blue Dragon Plus.name: Blue Dragon Plus
Blue Dragon Plus.summary:
A direct sequel to Blue Dragon that takes place a year after the first games events.

The game uses a real-time strategy style with characters being moved around a map using the stylus on the bottom screen and fighting enemies when they are close enough to attack.

Bob Esponja - Atrapados en el Congelador.name: SpongeBob's Truth or Square
Bob Esponja - Atrapados en el Congelador.summary: In the DS version of SpongeBob’s Truth Or Square, all attacks are available from the beginning, and there are some exclusive gameplay modes and minigames, plus 2 additional levels that were also seen in the PSP version.

Captain Sabertooth and the Trials by Fir.name: Captain Sabertooth and the Trials by Fire
Captain Sabertooth and the Trials by Fir.summary:
The Captain Sabertooth story follows the adventures of Tiny, in his quest to earn a place on the crew of Captain Sabertooth’s ship, the Dark Lady. Tiny desperately wants to become a pirate but finds it increasingly hard to get the pirates to take him seriously. The Captain and his pirates are hard to impress...

Tiny is challenged in everything from deck-scrubbing to treasure hunts, but makes a new friend in Raven, an Indian girl who stowed away on the Captain’s ship, Tiny sets out to win over the crew of the Dark Lady and earn his place on the ship.

Cheetah Girls, The - Pop Star Sensations.name: The Cheetah Girls: Pop Star Sensations
Cheetah Girls, The - Pop Star Sensations.summary: Select your favorite outfits, then dance along with the Cheetah Girls using your stylus and sing along into the DS mic.

Garfield Gets Real.name: Garfield Gets Real
Garfield Gets Real.summary: In Garfield Gets Real, players switch between Garfield and Odie as they play through seven areas of the game that all connect from the cartoon universe to the real world. Each area has a key story challenge that progresses the player through the game's chapters while completing 150 smaller tasks that will help them reach the key story challenges.

General Knowledge for Dummies.name: La Culture Generale pour les Nuls
General Knowledge for Dummies.summary: An edutainment game for the Nintendo DS.

GoldenEye - Au Service du Mal.name: GoldenEye: Rogue Agent
GoldenEye - Au Service du Mal.summary:
GoldenEye: Rogue Agent is a first-person shooter for Nintendo DS developed by EA Tiburon. The player takes the role of an ex-MI6 agent Jack Hunter, who is recruited by Auric Goldfinger to assassinate his rival Dr. No. Several other characters from the Bond series make appearances throughout the game, including Pussy Galore, Oddjob, Xenia Onatopp and Francisco Scaramanga.

The game is notable for being a fairly faithful recreation of its console counterpart despite hardware limitations and also for having its original game engine repurposed for a prototype build for the unreleased Halo DS.

Yu-Gi-Oh! GX - Card Almanac.name: Yu-Gi-Oh! GX Card Almanac
Yu-Gi-Oh! GX - Card Almanac.summary: Detailed catalog of all cards released in the TCG or OCG up until Strike of Neos. It also includes tools to aide in real-life gameplay (Life Point calculator, virtual dice roll and virtual coin flip)
